hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); goal=''; case "$f" in */src/main/*.java) goal=compileJava ;; */src/test/*.java) goal=compileTestJava ;; esac; if [ -n "$goal" ]; then cd /home/msuman/git/CertificateManager || exit 0; out=$(JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64 ./gradlew -q "$goal" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" != 0 ]; then clean=$(printf '%s' "$out" | sed -r 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'); esc=$(printf '%s' "$clean" | tail -c 3000 | jq -Rs .); printf '{"decision":"block","reason":%s}' "$esc"; fi; fi
